{{Infobox character | name = Arkose | image = Arkose.png | race = Hearthian | planet = Timber Hearth }}__NOTOC__ '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Hearthian]] found by the fence that surrounds [[Ghost Matter|ghost matter]] in the [[village]] outside of the entrance to the [[The Village#Zero-G Cave|zero-g cave]]. They are throwing rocks over the fence and into the invisible [[Ghost Matter|ghost matter]]. == Dialogue == === Initial Conversation === * Hi, astronaut!
You know the patch of ghost matter inside this fence? [[Gossan]] said it used to be bigger when they were a hatchling. 'Cause ghost matter evaporates.
It just takes a su-u-u-per long time to go away.
I hope there's still ghost matter in the village when I'm a grown-up. Ghost matter is awesome! **'''>Ghost matter is super cool. It'll burn the heck out of you!'''
(''Locks out other choices.'') *** Yeah! I heard touching it hurts so bad it feels like your whole hand's on fire!
Try not to walk into any in space, okay? That sounds bad and painful. **'''>You shouldn't be throwing rocks in there - ghost matter is dangerous.'''
(''Locks out other choices.'') *** Uhhh, obviously? That's what makes it so ''awesome''? Geez, I'm not dumb enough to ''touch'' it.
Ugh, you're such a grown-up. **'''>You know ghost matter is how [[Tektite]] lost their foot, right?'''
(''Locks out other choices.'') *** Whoa, really?! ...That is ''so cool''! === Followup Conversation === * It's cool that [[Little Scout]]s can detect ghost matter and all, but what would be ''really'' cool is if the Little Scout could, like, shoot ghost matter at stuff. All ''pew pew pew''! == Trivia == * If the Protagonist walks in front of a rock just as Arkose throws it, the rock can hit them, causing them to stumble slightly backwards. The rocks cause no damage, but can knock them into the ghost matter if they get in the way while standing on the fence. * As with all Hearthians, they are named after minerals. [[wikipedia:Arkose|Arkose]] or arkosic sandstone is a detrital sedimentary rock, specifically a type of sandstone containing at least 25% feldspar. [[Category:Hearthians]]
